content: Vibratome sections of mouse brain for immunohistochemistry are commonly cut at 30-50 micron thickness, with 40 micron being particularly common in practice; vibratomes reliably handle sections as thin as ~30 micron up to several hundred micron. Source: multiple vibratome-vendor and IHC-protocol web pages (ResearchGate Q&A, vibrotome.com, precisionary.com) -- MEDIUM confidence (cross-checked across >=3 independent web sources), not a single peer-reviewed citation.
